name: Forklift preventive maintenance
pain_points: Maintenance depends on physical inspection and hands-on repair; scheduling conflicts with warehouse operations; parts availability causes delays
data_used: Maintenance logs; equipment manuals; parts inventory

name: Annual performance review drafting and calibration
pain_points: Manager write-ups vary widely in quality and tone; calibration meetings are time-consuming to prepare; sensitive personal performance data must stay confidential
data_used: Manager narrative comments; prior review scores; HR calibration notes; employee personal file

name: Yearly insurance policy renewal
pain_points: Policy terms are complex and benefit from legal/insurance expertise; renewal is rushed near the deadline; comparing quotes across brokers is manual
data_used: Current policy documents; broker quotes; claims history; asset inventory

name: Live chat return authorization
pain_points: High volume of repetitive return-eligibility questions; agents must check multiple systems to verify purchase date and condition; inconsistent return decisions across agents
data_used: Order history; return policy rules; purchase date; product condition photos

name: Month-end bank reconciliation
pain_points: Manual matching of thousands of transactions against bank statements; any discrepancy must be traced to the exact transaction, with zero tolerance for error; close deadline pressure
data_used: Bank statements; general ledger transactions; prior reconciliation workpapers

name: Social media content calendar scheduling
pain_points: Manually copying approved content into each platform's scheduler; coordinating approval across multiple stakeholders; tracking which posts are pending versus published
data_used: Content calendar; approved creative assets; platform posting guidelines; approval sign-offs

name: IT incident ticket triage
pain_points: Tickets are inconsistently categorized by severity on submission; on-call engineers spend time just figuring out who should own a ticket; duplicate tickets for the same incident are not detected
data_used: Ticket descriptions; system logs; on-call rotation schedule; incident history

name: Field sales commission calculation
pain_points: Commission rules have many exceptions by region and product line; manual spreadsheet calculations are error-prone and disputed by reps; payroll deadline leaves little room for correction
data_used: Sales transactions; commission plan rules; rep territory assignments; payroll calendar

name: New hire onboarding paperwork processing
pain_points: New hires submit documents through multiple disconnected channels; HR manually checks each document against a compliance checklist; missing documents delay start-of-work system access
data_used: Employment contracts; ID and right-to-work documents; tax forms; IT provisioning checklist

name: Construction site safety inspection logging
pain_points: Inspectors write free-text notes that are inconsistent in detail; identifying recurring hazards across sites requires manually cross-referencing past reports; corrective actions are not tracked to completion automatically
data_used: Inspection checklists; site photos; incident history; corrective action logs
